items.text: RJ Harvey ruled out (knee) for Broncos vs Chiefs; Waddle questionable (chest).
items.implication: Unique role hard to replace; 3-6 extra targets available; Waddle Q adds uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Targets/carries open in DEN backfield/pass game; no clean handcuff.

items.text: Saquon Barkley has no injury designation for SNF vs Commanders despite recent hamstring/back issues and limited practice.
items.why: Cleared, no designation after limited Friday; played limited prior week.
items.implication: Start with volume but monitor for limitations; hard to believe 100%.
items.opportunity: Expected lead back role vs WAS.

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled out (hamstring) for Eagles vs Commanders; Dontayvion Wicks also out.
items.why: Official Eagles injury report; missed practice.
items.implication: Targets redistribute in PHI offense with Barkley back.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for remaining PHI WRs/TEs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson has no injury designation and is expected to play Sunday vs Bills after missing three games with ankle injury.
items.why: Full practices, official no designation, coach confirmation.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens pass catchers especially Flowers; small docks possible on rushing.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected with minor rushing limitation.

items.text: Colts now open to trading Jonathan Taylor; talks active/ongoing with multiple teams.
items.implication: ROS value depends on landing spot; monitor for Indy handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Potential new offense role if traded.

items.text: Breece Hall listed questionable (quad) again with cryptic tweets and trade rumors; was close last week.
items.why: Limited practice, Q tag, personal tweet ambiguity, trade buzz.
items.implication: Monitor closely; Braelon Allen beneficiary if out.
items.opportunity: If active, shared role possible; if out Allen full work.

items.text: Carnell Tate (shoulder) and Tyjae Spears (knee) OUT.
items.why: ETR Sunday board and Schefter OUT list.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining Titans skill players.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka (concussion, foot) taken out of projections; official OUT.
items.why: ETR removed from projs; Schefter OUT list confirms.
items.implication: Fallout in TB WR targets; check Godwin/others.

items.text: AJ Brown (knee) taken out of ETR projections initially; later listed Q on board, reports of multi-week.
items.why: ETR projs removed; conflicting Q vs multi-week reports.
items.implication: Fallout for NE WRs if confirmed out; TreVeyon Henderson also Q.
items.opportunity: Targets to other Patriots pass catchers.
items.conflict: ETR board later Q while Levitan out and reply multi-week.

items.text: Sell high on Quinshon Judkins after two-TD outing; role hit with Sampson return (snap/target share lows).
items.why: Sampson back cuts Judkins snaps/targets significantly from prior.
items.implication: Sell while value high; still lead but pass-game diminished.

items.text: Josh Jacobs strong fantasy via high-value touches like Jeanty: 3 inside-5 carries and 13 targets in two games post-suspension.
items.why: Goal-line and target work driving value over efficiency.
items.implication: Continue starting; parallel to Jeanty asset profile.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on Berry HATE list; production lacking and Chiefs allow few WR TDs.
items.why: Poor recent production; tough KC matchup (1 WR TD allowed).
items.conflict: Harvey OUT could boost but Berry still hates.

items.text: Zay Flowers is Berry's WR5 this week; LOVE with Lamar expected back unlocking him.
items.why: Lamar return boosts Ravens offense and Flowers.
items.implication: Strong start in likely track meet vs BUF.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG (top-5 TE) in two games since Caleb Williams return.
items.why: Leads TEs in utilization post-Williams return.
items.implication: Strong TE1/ streaming start ROS if continues.
items.opportunity: High target share in CHI offense.
